recommended_sequence.scope: Preserve current native full-physical-trace default and current legacy behavior. Add an explicit optional projection limit for deliberately migrated configurations at materialization/value ownership; never rewrite the source Episode to manufacture clipped provenance.
recommended_sequence.evidence: work/sequence-boundary/attempt001/result.json: identical actual requests, 651 prompt tokens and 28 completion tokens. Limit654 gives legacy3 actions versus native28 and different discounted terminal credit; limit650 gives legacy no samples. Within limit680 both match.
review_requirements: Projection limit defaults to None; legacy route keeps its existing parsing limit. No environment-ID-specific behavior.
Project aligned policy token/logprob/mask/routing streams and original sampled-mask provenance before immutable critic capture; rebuild clipped TrainingLayout spans where applicable.
No retained sampled tokens means no training sample, not terminal reward on a context token.

Preserve existing token-batch counters and length-penalty inputs: both num_total_tokens (last call usage) and num_output_tokens (aggregated provider usage) remain observed values despite clipped sample geometry. Do not silently redefine them as projected sample length.

Legacy truncation changes trace stop_condition, not original per-call finish_reason. Preserve observed Episode text/calls; compare actual overlength LOO prompt bytes without inventing finish-reason changes.

Prove supported single-turn migration against actual frozen legacy. Do not claim universal multi-turn/branch equivalence from a single flat-prefix example. Existing native branched semantics remain unchanged when projection disabled.
recommended_sequence.gate: Actual same-response producer -> TrainSink -> task and LOO credit/publication comparison for within-limit, completion-crossing and prompt-crossing cases; original Episode unchanged. No GPU necessary.

requirements: Unknown/default engine labels stay explicitly unknown in exact-token metrics; report coverage. Do not import upstream dispatch-version fallback as sampled-token truth.
Validate span bounds, ordering, overlap and coverage against original physical completion coordinates before mask projection; preserve unknown and non-sampled sentinel positions through packing.
Real generation paused across a weight update must return two correctly aligned version spans; startup labels and filesystem/NCCL paths need coverage for supported configurations.
Token provenance is distinct from critic evaluator version, replay age and group dispatch version.
Keep cde40c64 stale-token masking/cancellation changes, sampling replay and score-centering/EMA objectives out of this observability unit.

compatibility_options.recommended: Develop new producer/backend on an explicit native-supported branch/profile (RG plus reverse-text initially); preserve frozen current-stack source/lock for historical legacy execution. Reject unsupported legacy configuration before allocating resources. This does not require porting all69 declared legacy entries and does not claim universal backward compatibility.
compatibility_options.if_simultaneous_legacy_is_required: A separately pinned legacy worker project plus explicit final-Episode to new protocol/schema adapter is possible, but must carry cancellation, errors, joint-group scoring and precise token arrays. Do not vendor v0 into value code or assume old/new ZMQ clients interoperate. This additional maintenance burden is not currently justified by an actual mixed workflow.
compatibility_options.math: Do not automatically switch old math examples: native research-environments304 changes dataset default, boxed-answer acceptance, metadata/shuffling and verifier/timeouts. No saved non-RG math research workload establishes it as a prerequisite.
compatibility_options.reverse_text: Same default prompt/scorer is promising; named metric lcs versus lcs_reward_func and the demonstrated sequence boundary still need explicit preservation before replacing configurations.
